n.name: North Zone
n.bounds: North Zone as mapped by NJDEP (zone wording is in NJ Fish & Wildlife’s waterfowl zones description).
n.note: Ducks Oct 10–17, Nov 14 – Jan 14. Canada geese Nov 21–30, Dec 19 – Jan 30 (3). Youth day Oct 3.

s.name: South Zone
s.bounds: South Zone as mapped by NJDEP.
s.note: Ducks Oct 17–24, Nov 21 – Jan 21. Canada geese Nov 21–30, Dec 19 – Jan 30 (3). Youth day Oct 10.

c.name: Coastal Zone
c.bounds: Coastal Zone as mapped by NJDEP.
c.note: Ducks Nov 21 – Jan 29. Canada geese Nov 21 – Jan 29 (2). Youth day Nov 14.

seasonsNote: Duck, brant and Canada goose dates differ by zone (North, South, Coastal). No migratory game bird hunting on Sundays.

seasons.label: Sea ducks
seasons.note: Scoters, long-tailed ducks and eiders; crippled birds may be shot from a boat under power only in the Special Sea Duck Area.

seasons.label: Canada geese — September
seasons.note: Shooting to ½ hour after sunset; up to 7 shells; electronic calls allowed.

seasons.label: Canada geese — regular
seasons.note: Cackling and white-fronted geese count with Canada geese. Special Winter season Feb 1–15 in the two mapped areas (5 a day).

seasons.label: Light geese — regular
seasons.note: Snow and Ross’s geese; starts and ends three weeks later than usual. Conservation Order to be determined.

seasons.label: American woodcock
seasons.note: North woodcock zone Oct 24–31 and Nov 3 – Dec 5; South woodcock zone Nov 7 – Dec 5 and Dec 19–31 (woodcock zones differ from waterfowl zones). Sunrise to sunset.

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.
Common, red-breasted and hooded, in addition to the duck limit.
Inside the 6: no more than 3 scoters, 3 long-tailed ducks or 3 eiders (1 hen eider).
North and South Zones 3 (up from 2); Coastal Zone 2. Special Winter season 5.
Sora and Virginia rails, in aggregate.
Ducks, geese, brant, mergansers, coots and gallinules at each zone’s limits, but 2 scaup.

duckSublimits.note: no more than 3 scoters, 3 long-tailed ducks, 3 eiders (1 hen)
teal, bufflehead, gadwall, goldeneye, ring-necked, ruddy, shoveler, wigeon up to the full bag

rules.d: Migratory game bird hunting is not permitted on Sundays in New Jersey.
One-half hour before sunrise to sunset; September Canada geese and the light goose Conservation Order to ½ hour after sunset; woodcock sunrise to sunset.
Non-toxic shot for waterfowl, rails and snipe. No more than 3 shells (7 for September Canada geese and the Conservation Order); electronic calls only in those two.

No open season for any game birds or animals, waterfowl included: the Shark River (Monmouth) and its shores; the Manasquan River from the inlet to the Route 70 bridge; Herring Island and the part of Barnegat Bay beside it; Parker Creek and Oceanport Creek above the Conrail bridge; the non-tidal parts of Cox Hall Creek WMA; Barnegat Inlet west of the COLREGS line. Red on the map.
Waterfowl hunting on the Delaware River follows the state boundary and each state’s seasons.
Youth only: Oct 3 (North), Oct 10 (South), Nov 14 (Coastal). Veterans / active military only: Oct 31. Youth and veterans / military: Feb 6, statewide.
It is unlawful to waste the breast meat of migratory game birds. Leave a head or wing on until home (federal rule).

licences.d: Resident or non-resident firearm licence, from NJ Fish & Wildlife.

geometryNote: Geometry: zone lines from NJDEP’s official Waterfowl Hunting Zones layer (shared edges, matched within 3 m; the South / Coastal line carried on to the Census line in Delaware Bay), split against the Census TIGER outline; NJDEP closed areas, state open space and public access locations; USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA CO-OPS (tides); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders); OpenStreetMap (roads).
